final: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), kept AS (SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount FROM per_event WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM per_event)), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_kept FROM kept) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM per_event) AS above_overall_average, avg_amount - (SELECT mean_kept FROM kept_mean) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
